mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, it is 39 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall, though it feels closer to 29 degrees. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city is promoting its digital newsletter, which keeps you informed on projects and city programs, and the Public Works Department reminds residents that they are hard at work maintaining our streets, sewers, and utilities.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music at Paddy Mac's and yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee today, and trivia at the Bogey Factory tomorrow.

In police news, on November 11, officers arrested a 54-year-old woman for bail jumping in the area of Whalen Road and South Main Street after she falsely claimed police were looking for her while under the influence of alcohol.
If you are looking for a treat, today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
